note: Refused POST attempts, recorded since the attempt counter began (the Oct 18, 2026 deployment). An attempt is a knock, not a submission: successful POSTs are not counted here — each channel counts its own (see successes) — and request bodies are never stored. A stored refusal code of '' means the refusal body was not JSON; it is published here as 'no-code (non-JSON refusal)'. Days are UTC days in by_day, as recorded; by_day_pt folds the same rows by Pacific day. Origin (Oct 19, 2026): 'steward-test' knocks are the stewards' own verification attempts, labelled at write time from this build forward and backfilled once for the rows already on record from the Oct 18/19 build record; everything else is 'external'. content_length records a refused POST's declared body size in bytes (by_length) — a number, never the body; rows from before Oct 19, 2026 carry none and fold into 'not recorded'.

successes.note: The same channels' successes, read from the channels' own counters in the same keyed pull as the refusals above. A refusal count beside a success count is context, not a rate.
